crop.notes: Clipping holds two items: 'The Ring. Ben Hogan's Latest Bluff' (top, the Allen mention) and an unrelated 'Ten-Pins' item below.

ocr.notes: Minor errors ('soper sees' for 'temperance', 'himseif'); Ten-Pins item also transcribed.

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat reported from New York that Ben Hogan, who it said was beaten by Tom Allen at Omaha for $2,000 and the championship of America, had been converted by the Gospel Temperance Society.

metadata.notes: Page 16 supplemental sheet; New York dispatch dated September 21.

facts.fact: The Globe-Democrat said Allen beat Ben Hogan at Omaha for $2,000 and the championship of America

notes: Hogan's own later account (article 619) calls the fight a draw; the paper's 'licked' claim is secondhand. Fight year not stated in the article.
